# Retired inherited references

All inherited numerical payloads have been removed. No file in this directory is
an approved initial-release reference. Necessary scenarios and independent expectation
recipes belong beside their maintained test families.

Current-engine snapshots remain provisional until explicit acceptance under a stated
validation scope. Approved deterministic coaxial replay uses `test/numerical/approved.toml`;
that manifest remains empty. Do not regenerate rejected expectations after a failure.
